name: AnimeJapan
blurb: One of the world's largest anime industry expos, with exhibitor booths, stage programmes and merchandise; moving to Osaka for 2027.

editions.evidence: Homepage hero image text: 'Held at INTEX Osaka, March 27 (Sat) - 28 (Sun), 2027!'

notes: The seed URL (animejapan.jp, no hyphen) is broken: the apex domain returns a persistent 502 Bad Gateway and www.animejapan.jp is an unrelated parked/for-sale domain. The real official site is anime-japan.jp (with a hyphen). For 2027 the event moves from Tokyo Big Sight to INTEX Osaka for the first time in its history, because Tokyo Big Sight is under renovation; some secondary sources mention an additional trade-only business day on March 26, but the official homepage itself only states the Mar 27-28 range quoted above, so that is what is recorded. Stage/guest lineup not yet announced.
